full_details: At nine you were a line early, because father is said twice and only the second is your cue. Augustine Phillips set eight bars under the entrance instead of four. Garnish marked the plot and would not rewrite the book. No new song. You did not give the old man a name. At two you played. Between the rehearsal and the play you pushed the Worthies a page further. They lose the names. Nothing follows. No messenger is written. The Rose's bill is Knack. You did not go.
one_sentence: You rehearsed the Shrew, played the old man with the message at two, and left the Worthies at the laugh.
title: Rehearsed the Shrew and played the old man
